title: Mujaki the Devourer
summary: Intercept the servants approaching Mujaki’s platform, then defeat Mujaki the Devourer.
overview: Intercept the servants approaching Mujaki’s platform, then defeat Mujaki the Devourer.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Clear the nightmare steeds around the platform to start the event.
Seven waves bring thirty-six servants in total from three grave sites. Intercept them before they reach the platform: unengaged servants that arrive become mounted riders.
Each wave is timed, so avoid letting stronger riders and fresh servants accumulate together.
When all thirty-six servants have either died or transformed, Mujaki becomes attackable. Control the remaining riders while defeating him.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
